tables_summary.name: patientinfo
tables_summary.description: Basic identifying information about the patient (dob, chart number, ssn), demographic information for the patient, and some medical or social history questions as customized by the clinic.

tables_summary.name: charges
tables_summary.description: All CPT charges associated with the patient's account

tables_summary.name: healthmaintenance
tables_summary.description: Scheduled recurrent diagnostic labs or tests the provider associated with the patient.

tables_summary.name: patient_codes
tables_summary.description: Codes of various code systems associated with the patient

tables_summary.name: patient_forms_data
tables_summary.description: Forms filled out for the patient

tables_summary.name: patient_guarantor
tables_summary.description: Guarantor information and demographics associated with the patient

tables_summary.name: patient_letters
tables_summary.description: Letters written by the clinic that are associated with the patient

tables_summary.name: patient_pmp
tables_summary.description: Prescription monitoring program database results for the patient.

tables_summary.name: patient_referrals
tables_summary.description: Referrals sent out to other providers on behalf of the patient

tables_summary.name: ptinr
tables_summary.description: For patient requires periodic prothrombin time(PT) and international normalized ratio(INR) tests, this documents the reason for the test and the frequency decided by the provider

tables_summary.name: ptinr_log
tables_summary.description: Logs all pt/inr test results for the patient; Connected to ptinr table.

tables_summary.name: schedules
tables_summary.description: Scheduled appointments associated with the patient.
